user.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer
user.description: Adds a read-only map of your Zigbee and Thread networks to the sidebar. Nothing needs to be configured.

init.title: Meshroute Topology Explorer Options
init.description: Changes take effect when you save; Home Assistant itself is not restarted.

data_description.sidebar: Off removes the panel from the sidebar and from the address /meshroute-topology.

history.name: Reception history
history.description: Records the reception values of the neighbour tables that ZHA and the Matter server already hold: Zigbee after each of ZHA's own topology scans, Thread every 4 hours. It never starts a scan.

data_description.delete_history: Deletes all records when you save. Not kept as a setting.

zha.name: Zigbee (ZHA)
zha.description:
{zha_scan}. To change it, add this to configuration.yaml (merge it with an existing `zha:` block) and restart Home Assistant Core:

```yaml
zha:
  zigpy_config:
    topology_scan_period: 240
```

Minutes, at least 20. Scans more often than every 3 hours mean more radio traffic in the whole network.

data.radio_actions: Allow scan and attribute reads in the panel
data.scan_after_start: Scan once 30 minutes after Home Assistant starts

data_description.radio_actions: Off hides the scan button and the attribute read in the panel. It is a switch of this panel, not a lock: ZHA's own pages still offer both.
data_description.scan_after_start: Asks ZHA for one topology scan, once per start, if scan and attribute reads are allowed, no scan is running and the last Zigbee record is older than ZHA's period. It is ZHA's own scan (radio traffic); the result is recorded like any other.
